To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the energy landscape of a protein can be modeled as a transition network, (2) this transition network can be constructed using automated path-optimizing methods, (3) the dynamics of the protein can be modeled using a Markov State Model, which is constructed by adaptive graph-theoretical methods, (4) the Markov State Model can be used to interpret the dynamics of the transition network, and (5) the Markov state model can be improved using statistical concepts.
